id./param/scenario/cs/a_150_cs_130.pack|cs_: "Why have you brought me here?
"That voice! It's music to my ears! Oh darling, tell me, is it you, my one and only Kai?
"Yeah, I'm Kai. Do I know you?
"What!? You're a mermaid!
"Oh, silly me, I'm always far too quick to jump for joy. You're not my darling boy...
"No, I'm not. The man you loved was my grandfather. But he's not here any more...
"My darling Kai... You died alone and friendless on this cold and windswept shore...?
"Oh, how could I forget we mermaids live five hundred years? A human life just ups and disappears...
"Without Kai, the hours seemed to pass too slowly...but cruel time was flowing faster than I knew...
"Thanks for finding Kai for me. You've been a proper friend, to trace my love across the sea until the bitter end...
"I said I would reward you, and I mean to pay that debt. You'll find your prize upon the island where we met.
"I'm sorry I can't come along. Now I'm here, I can't go back. I think I have to stay...
Michelle sang a bewitching melody that echoed off the cliffs...
"I waited for you so long, through sun and stormy weather...but now at long, long last, we're going to be together...
Michelle gently kissed Kainoa's grave...
Kainui held out his hand to the fallen Michelle.
"You've got your grandad's hands, you know. So soft, yet strong and honest.
"A mermaid who sets foot on land will perish in the brine...but that's alright. I got to meet my darling one last time.
"If I had been a human, or if he had been like me, perhaps we could have lived together, happy as can be...
"But I'm a mermaid, he's a man. He was my one true love, but now...goodbye...
"I can't stop thinking I've seen her somewhere before... Of course, Grandpa's cabin!
